# Data Dictionary

This file is generated by `tools/validate.py` from the validated release records. The editorial notes at the end are maintained separately because they express scholarly interpretation.

## Scope

`Jinteng 金縢` contains graph-level transcriptions, correspondences, optional source and crop mappings, schemas, and a static viewer. `dataset/manifest.json` declares the witness list, alignment anchor, and report order used by the viewer and validator.

## Witnesses and transcriptions

| ID | Witness | Units | Paragraphs | Graphs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `shangshu` | 傳本《尚書·金縢》 | 1 | 8 | 485 |
| `tsinghua` | 清華簡壹《金縢》 | 1 | 4 | 411 |

Each `dataset/<witness>/transcription.json` contains an ordered array of units. Unit, paragraph, and graph coordinates are one-based; graph numbering continues across the lines in a paragraph. A Unicode graph and a braced IDS or uncertain reading each occupy one graph position. Whitespace and Unicode punctuation occupy none. Lacunae (`□` or `〼`) and iteration marks (`𖿣`) each occupy one position.

## Alignment

`dataset/alignment.json` contains 307 correspondence groups comprising 616 graph locations: 305 with 2 locations, 2 with 3 locations. Each group joins at least two witnesses; every location is within its transcription and occurs in at most one group.

## Source mappings and media

| Witness | Source edition | DPI | Text-to-source mappings | Strip crops | Character crops | Crop classifications |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `tsinghua` | `li_xueqin_2010_QinghuaDaxueCang` | 300 | 400 | 57 | 441 | graph: 400, punctuation: 27, strip_number: 14 |

`source_mapping.json` maps a transcription position to a physical source location (`pdf_page`, string `strip`, and one-based `item`). `strip_mapping.json` maps rendered source-PDF rectangles to strip images; `character_mapping.json` maps strip-local rectangles to derived crops. Every crop box is `[left, top, right, bottom]` in pixels.

`expected_media.json` records the reviewed source-PDF SHA-256 digest, rendering resolution, and expected PNG byte hashes, decoded-pixel hashes, modes, and dimensions for all 498 distributed image files. Source PDFs and uncropped plates are excluded from the release; see `../witness-images/RIGHTS.md`.

## Validation

`tools/validate.py` checks schemas, bibliography keys, transcription coordinates, alignment uniqueness, lacuna restrictions, mapping consistency, expected-media coverage, and image checksums.

## Editorial notes

The alignment preserves explicit scholarly decisions recorded during review,
including insertions, omissions, reordered material, and graph-level variant
correspondences. Parenthetical material in the review notes is contextual and
is not automatically aligned.
